{{Quote|Will you two be quiet? This is still a mission. Oh, and there's somebody coming.|Hohass Ekwesh|<ref name="MK" />}}
The '''raid on Mulvar sensor station''' was a covert operation conducted by [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit within the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Intelligence|Intelligence]], on the [[Mulvar Sensor Station]] located in [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Imperial Space|space]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> The Wraiths infiltrated the station by sending [[Voort saBinring]] undercover as a maintenance worker to learn the base's security routine. He also facilitated the growth of a harmless fungal stain on one of the Tower's windows, prompting the [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Mulvar Sensor Station)|officer]] in charge to have the base's [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and their sensor triggers disabled so that saBinring could clean them. After cleaning the window, saBinring [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the [[Unidentified Tower Three guard|guard]] assigned to the tower and assisted in allowing his Wraith compatriots, [[Shalla Nelprin]] and [[Hohass Ekwesh]], to enter the base.<ref name="MK" />  

The three Wraiths proceeded to the base's scientific section, where Nelprin efficiently took down the troopers they encountered without raising an alarm. saBinring then entered codes provided to him by [[Wraith Leader (callsign)|Wraith Leader]], [[Garik Loran]], into a console that transmitted them to faraway sensor facilities. The codes caused malfunctions in orbital deep-space scanners, stellar light harvesters and interpreters, and comm-frequency listening posts. Some of the facilities transmitted incorrect information to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Imperial High Command|High Command]] Center under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]'s indirect control, while others initiated self-destruct sequences. Still others shut down all transmissions and repositioned themselves, burning all their [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] in successful efforts to fly into their nearest sun.<ref name="MK" />  

After uploading the code, saBinring planted explosives. The Wraiths then watched the detonation from a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] away, destroying the laboratory building while causing as little casualties as possible.<ref name="MK" />
